name: Catherine Clinton
abstract_title: Possibility for Body Wide Consciousness Orchestration via Pi Electrons and Excitons – Quantum Biology of Consciousness, Water, Fascia and Mitochondria
abstract: The Orchestra Objective Reduction theory of consciousness focuses on the pi electrons in the microtubules of the neurons of the brain as quantum qubits. Is it possible that consciousness can be orchestrated through pi electrons and excitons that exist in the interfacial water, biomolecules and mitochondria of the body?
